acceptanceCriteria: An option tees runner stdout/stderr to a caller-named file or passes it through on stderr, covered by a test
The runner exit status is recorded in the receipt (or a sidecar) and documented
Console capture beyond the bound truncates and continues (the report file carries the observation) or the bound is configurable; a >4 MiB fake runner completes
Spec requirements added for the new options and receipt field
body: GitHub #1131. internal/jstestprovider/external.go:182 runs the Playwright command through procgroup with OutputLimit externalOutputLimit (4 MiB, overflow fails the run), never forwards or retains stdout/stderr, and does not expose the runner exit status (provider exits 0 for any observed run). Expected: callers that classify results from console output and exit status can adopt the provider; verbose suites are not terminated. Actual: output is swallowed, exit status hidden, >4 MiB console output kills the run mid-suite.
title: GH #1131: js-test-provider external-server mode must expose runner output and exit status, and not kill a run whose console output exceeds 4 MiB
